gusto.com (formerly ZenPayroll); YC-backed; HQ San Francisco. Series C $140M (Jul 2018, T. Rowe Price, YC Continuity, General Catalyst; ~$2B+), Series D $200M (Jul 2019, Fidelity & Generation; $3.8B), Series E $175M (Aug 2021, T. Rowe Price; $9.5B; Emerson Collective participated), Series E extension May 2022 (undisclosed, reportedly ~ $55M per TechCrunch via Finovate). amount_raised = ~$746M total reported by Finovate (citing TechCrunch reporting) around the extension - approximate. Seed/Series A not itemized; still private. A 2015 ~$50M Series B (CapitalG, General Catalyst) is reported but not verified from a primary source, so it is not itemized.
